source.translation: R. H. Charles, The Book of Jubilees or the Little Genesis (SPCK, London, 1917; Translations of Early Documents)
source.retrieved_via: https://web.archive.org/web/2023id_/https://sacred-texts.com/bib/jub/ (sacred-texts.com blocked automated fetch with a Cloudflare challenge)

people.name: Adam
people.description: The first man; father of Cain, Abel, Seth, Awan and Azura.

explicit_ages.what: lifespan (seventy years short of a thousand)

people.identity_note: 13:23 "Adam" is the city (Admah) and is excluded. Death dated 4:29 (close of 19th jubilee, 7th week, 6th year).

people.name: Eve
people.description: The first woman, wife of Adam.
people.identity_note: Named only at 3:33 and 4:10; elsewhere "his wife"/"the woman"/"she".

people.name: Cain
people.description: Firstborn son of Adam and Eve; killed Abel and was later killed when his house fell on him.
people.identity_note: Father in 4:1 is implied by 3:34 ("he knew her") with Eve as the one who gave birth.

people.name: Abel
people.description: Second son of Adam and Eve, killed by Cain.

people.name: Âwân
people.description: Daughter of Adam and Eve who became the wife of her brother Cain.
people.identity_note: Charles prints ’Âwân. Mapped to existing cain-wife (Genesis leaves her unnamed); Jubilees names her and makes her Cain's sister.

people.name: Azûrâ
people.description: Daughter of Adam and Eve who became the wife of her brother Seth.
people.identity_note: 4:8 "he begat his daughter Azura" (Adam); Eve as mother is implied by context (4:7-8).

people.name: Seth
people.description: Son of Adam and Eve born after Abel's death; father of Enos.

people.name: Enoch
people.description: Son of Cain and Awan; Cain named his city after him.

people.name: Enos
people.description: Son of Seth and Azura; father of Kenan.

people.name: Nôâm
people.description: Wife of Enos, called his sister; mother of Kenan.
people.identity_note: Text calls her "his sister" (Enos's), i.e. a daughter of Seth, but no parent is named.

people.name: Kenan
people.description: Son of Enos and Noam; father of Mahalalel.

people.name: Mûalêlêth
people.description: Wife of Kenan, called his sister; mother of Mahalalel.
people.identity_note: Text calls her "his sister" (Kenan's); no parent named.

people.name: Mahalalel
people.description: Son of Kenan and Mualeleth; father of Jared.

people.name: Dînâh
people.description: Wife of Mahalalel, daughter of Barakiel; mother of Jared.
people.identity_note: Described as "the daughter of his father's brother" (Mahalalel's first cousin), so Barakiel was a brother of Kenan; Barakiel's own parents are not named.

people.name: Barâkî’êl
people.description: Father of Dinah, the wife of Mahalalel; a brother of Kenan by implication.
people.identity_note: Distinct from Bârâkî’îl, father of Betenos (4:28), who lived generations later.

people.name: Jared
people.description: Son of Mahalalel and Dinah, in whose days the Watchers descended; father of Enoch.

people.name: Bâraka
people.description: Wife of Jared, daughter of Rasujal; mother of Enoch.
people.identity_note: Described as "a daughter of his father's brother" (Jared's cousin).

people.name: Râsûjâl
people.description: Father of Baraka, the wife of Jared; a brother of Mahalalel by implication.

people.name: Enoch
people.description: Son of Jared and Baraka; first to learn writing, taken into Eden; father of Methuselah.
people.identity_note: 4:21 says he was with the angels "six jubilees of years"; 4:23 he was taken into the Garden of Eden.

people.name: Ednî
people.description: Wife of Enoch, daughter of Danel; mother of Methuselah.
people.identity_note: Charles spells Ednî here (Enoch's wife) vs Ednâ (Methuselah's wife, 4:27); his footnote compares "Edna in 1 Enoch lxxxv. 3" (where Edna is Enoch's wife). Described as daughter of "his father's brother".

people.name: Dânêl
people.description: Father of Edni, the wife of Enoch; a brother of Jared by implication.

people.name: Methuselah
people.description: Son of Enoch and Edni; father of Lamech.

people.name: Ednâ
people.description: Wife of Methuselah, daughter of Azrial; mother of Lamech.
people.identity_note: Described as daughter of "his father's brother".

people.name: Âzrîâl
people.description: Father of Edna, the wife of Methuselah.

people.name: Lamech
people.description: Son of Methuselah and Edna; father of Noah.

people.name: Bêtênôs
people.description: Wife of Lamech, daughter of Barakiil; mother of Noah.
people.identity_note: Described as daughter of "his father's brother".

people.name: Bârâkî’îl
people.description: Father of Betenos, the wife of Lamech.
people.identity_note: Not the same man as Barakiel father of Dinah (4:15); generations apart.

people.name: Noah
people.description: Son of Lamech and Betenos; built the ark; father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
people.identity_note: 10:15-16 his death: 950 years = "nineteen jubilees and two weeks and five years".

people.name: Ĕmzârâ
people.description: Wife of Noah, daughter of Rakeel; mother of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
people.identity_note: Mapped to existing noah-wife (unnamed in Genesis). Described as daughter of "his father's brother".

people.name: Râkê’êl
people.description: Father of Emzara, the wife of Noah.

people.name: Shem
people.description: Eldest son of Noah, who received the middle of the earth by lot.
people.identity_note: 9:2 reads "Sherri" in the scanned text, an OCR error for Shem. 10:14 calls him Noah's eldest son.

people.name: Ham
people.description: Son of Noah; father of Cush, Mizraim, Put and Canaan.

people.name: Japheth
people.description: Son of Noah; his portion was the north.

people.name: Sêdêqêtêlĕbâb
people.description: Wife of Shem; Shem named his city after her.
people.identity_note: Mapped to existing wife-shem. 7:17 uses the name for the city.

people.name: Nê’êlâtamâ’ûk
people.description: Wife of Ham; Ham named his city after her.
people.identity_note: Mapped to existing wife-ham. 7:17 spells the city Na’êlâtamâ’ûk.

people.name: ’Adâtanêsês
people.description: Wife of Japheth; Japheth named his city after her.
people.identity_note: Mapped to existing wife-japheth. 7:17 uses the name for the city.

people.name: Cush
people.description: Son of Ham.

people.name: Mizraim
people.description: Son of Ham.

people.name: Put
people.description: Son of Ham.

people.name: Canaan
people.description: Youngest son of Ham, cursed by Noah; seized land in Shem's portion.
people.identity_note: Most other "Canaan" occurrences are the land or the Canaanites and are not counted. 10:29-34 narrate his settling in Lebanon/Canaan.

people.name: Elam
people.description: Son of Shem; father of Rasueja (wife of Arpachshad).

people.name: Asshur
people.description: Son of Shem.
people.identity_note: "Asshur" is also used for the land/mountains (8:21, 9:5, 9:6, 10:26, 13:1); only person references counted.

people.name: Arpachshad
people.description: Son of Shem born two years after the flood; father of Kainam.
people.identity_note: 7:18: born two years after the flood.

people.name: Lud
people.description: Son of Shem.

people.name: Aram
people.description: Son of Shem.
people.identity_note: Later "Aram" (34:20, 37:6, 37:9, 41:1) is the land/people.

people.name: Gomer
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Magog
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Javan
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Tubal
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Meshech
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Tiras
people.description: Son of Japheth.

people.name: Madai
people.description: Son of Japheth who settled in Media near his wife's brother Arpachshad.

people.name: Wife of Madai
people.description: Wife of Madai; sister of Arpachshad (hence a daughter of Shem by implication).
people.identity_note: 10:35 calls Arpachshad "his wife's brother"; she is not named.

people.name: Râsû’ĕjâ
people.description: Wife of Arpachshad, daughter of Elam; mother of Kainam.
people.identity_note: Text: "Râsû’ĕjâ, [the daughter of Sûsân,] the daughter of Elam". Charles brackets "the daughter of Sûsân"; Sûsân (Susa) appears elsewhere only as a place (8:21, 9:2), so it is not entered as a person. Elam is taken as her father; if the bracketed words are original he would be her grandfather.

people.name: Kâinâm
people.description: Son of Arpachshad; found and copied the Watchers' astrological teaching; father of Shelah.

people.name: Mêlkâ
people.description: Wife of Kainam, daughter of Madai son of Japheth; mother of Shelah.

people.name: Shelah
people.description: Son of Kainam and Melka; father of Eber.

people.name: Mû’ak
people.description: Wife of Shelah, daughter of Kesed; mother of Eber.
people.identity_note: Kesed is called "his father's brother" (Shelah's uncle).

people.name: Kêsêd
people.description: Brother of Kainam (by 8:6 "his father's brother"); father of Mu'ak and of Ur.
people.identity_note: Not identical with Chesed son of Nahor (Gen 22:22). His own parentage (Arpachshad) is implied, not stated.

people.name: Eber
people.description: Son of Shelah and Mu'ak; father of Peleg.

people.name: ’Azûrâd
people.description: Wife of Eber, daughter of Nebrod; mother of Peleg.

people.name: Nêbrôd
people.description: Father of Azurad, the wife of Eber.
people.identity_note: Nebrod is the Greek form of Nimrod, but Jubilees gives no further identification (no link to Cush); kept separate from nimrod.

people.name: Peleg
people.description: Son of Eber, named for the division of the earth; father of Reu.

people.name: Lômnâ
people.description: Wife of Peleg, daughter of Sinaar; mother of Reu.

people.name: Sînâ’ar
people.description: Father of Lomna, the wife of Peleg.
people.identity_note: The name resembles Shinar, but here it is a person.

people.name: Reu
people.description: Son of Peleg and Lomna; father of Serug.

people.name: ’Ôrâ
people.description: Wife of Reu, daughter of Ur son of Kesed; mother of Serug.

people.name: ’Ûr
people.description: Son of Kesed; builder of the city ’Arâ of the Chaldees; father of Ora.
people.identity_note: 11:3: he built ’Arâ of the Chaldees and named it after himself and his father. "Ur of the Chaldees" (city) is not counted.

people.name: Serug
people.description: Son of Reu and Ora, first called Seroh; idol-worshipper in Ur; father of Nahor.

people.name: Mêlkâ
people.description: Wife of Serug, daughter of Kaber; mother of Nahor.
people.identity_note: Described as daughter of "his father's brother".

people.name: Kâbêr
people.description: Father of Melka, the wife of Serug.

people.name: Nahor
people.description: Son of Serug and Melka, taught Chaldean divination; father of Terah.

people.name: ’Îjâskâ
people.description: Wife of Nahor, daughter of Nestag of the Chaldees; mother of Terah.

people.name: Nêstâg
people.description: A Chaldean, father of Ijaska the wife of Nahor.

people.name: Terah
people.description: Son of Nahor and Ijaska; father of Abram, Nahor, Haran and Sarai.
people.identity_note: 34:20 "of the seed of the sons of Terah" refers to his descendants.

people.name: ’Êdnâ
people.description: Wife of Terah, daughter of ’Abrâm; mother of Abram.
people.identity_note: 11:14: "the daughter of his father's sister" (Terah's cousin).

people.name: ’Abrâm
people.description: Father of Edna, the wife of Terah; Abram was named after him; died before his grandson was born.
people.identity_note: Charles distinguishes the spelling ’Abrâm here.

people.name: Abram
people.description: Son of Terah and Edna, renamed Abraham; father of Ishmael, Isaac and the sons of Keturah.

explicit_ages.what: age when he drove off the ravens
age when he burned the house of idols

people.identity_note: 21:2 and 22:7 also give 175 when he blesses Isaac/Jacob shortly before his death. 15:17 he speaks of himself as "a hundred years old" at Isaac's promised birth.

people.name: Sarai
people.description: Wife and half-sister of Abram (daughter of Terah), renamed Sarah; mother of Isaac.

explicit_ages.what: age at the promise of Isaac

people.identity_note: 12:9: "Sarai, the daughter of his father". Her mother is not named (not said to be Edna).

people.name: Haran
people.description: Brother of Abram, died in the fire at the house of idols; father of Lot.
people.identity_note: 12:14 "he died in Ur of the Chaldees before Terah his father". "Haran" elsewhere is the city.

people.name: Wife of Haran
people.description: Unnamed wife of Haran and mother of Lot.

people.name: Nahor
people.description: Brother of Abram; husband of Melca; grandfather of Rebecca.
people.identity_note: 12:11 "Nahor, his brother" (Abram's). Terah as father is implied but not stated in Jubilees.

people.name: Mêlcâ
people.description: Wife of Nahor brother of Abraham; mother of Bethuel.

people.name: Lot
people.description: Son of Haran, nephew of Abram; dwelt in Sodom and was saved from its overthrow.
people.identity_note: 16:8 says he sinned with his daughters (unnamed, not entered separately).

people.name: Pharaoh
people.description: King of Egypt who seized Sarai and was plagued.

people.name: Chedorlaomer
people.description: King of Elam who raided Sodom and captured Lot.

people.name: Amraphel
people.description: King of Shinar in the raid on Sodom.

people.name: Arioch
people.description: King of Sêllâsar in the raid on Sodom.

people.name: Têrgâl
people.description: "King of nations" in the raid on Sodom.
people.identity_note: Jubilees form of Tidal (Gen 14:1).

people.name: King of Sodom
people.description: The king of Sodom who fled the raiders and later asked Abram for the captives.
people.identity_note: Unnamed in Jubilees; identified with Bera of Genesis 14:2.

people.name: King of Gomorrah
people.description: The king of Gomorrah, whom Jubilees says the raiders slew.
people.identity_note: Unnamed in Jubilees; identified with Birsha of Genesis 14:2. Jubilees (unlike Genesis) says he was slain.

people.name: Aner
people.description: Ally of Abram.

people.name: Eschol
people.description: Ally of Abram.

people.name: Mamre
people.description: Ally of Abram.
people.identity_note: Other "Mamre" occurrences are the place (oak of Mamre).

people.name: Eliezer
people.description: Abram's presumptive heir, "the Dammasek Eliezer", son of Abram's handmaid.
people.identity_note: 14:2: "the son of Mâsêq, the son of my handmaid, is the Dammasek Eliezer". Mâsêq is not entered as a person (it renders Gen 15:2 ben-mesheq; it is unclear whether a person is meant).

people.name: Hagar
people.description: Sarai's Egyptian maid, given to Abram as wife; mother of Ishmael; died before Sarah.

people.name: Ishmael
people.description: Son of Abram and Hagar; archer; father of twelve sons including Nebaioth.

people.name: Wife of Ishmael
people.description: Egyptian woman chosen by Hagar as Ishmael's wife; mother of Nebaioth.

people.name: Nebaioth
people.description: Son of Ishmael.

people.name: Isaac
people.description: Son of Abraham and Sarah; husband of Rebecca; father of Esau and Jacob.

explicit_ages.what: age when Jacob visited him at Bethel time

people.identity_note: 36:18 also gives "twenty-five weeks and five years" (=180).

people.name: Keturah
people.description: Abraham's third wife, from the daughters of his household servants; mother of six sons.

people.name: Zimram
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Jokshan
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Medan
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Midian
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Ishbak
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Shuah
people.description: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

people.name: Bethuel
people.description: Son of Nahor and Melca; father of Rebecca and Laban.

people.name: Rebecca
people.description: Daughter of Bethuel, wife of Isaac, mother of Esau and Jacob.
people.identity_note: 35:6 she foresees she will not live beyond 155; 35:27 she dies "three jubilees and one week and one year old" (=155).

people.name: Laban
people.description: Son of Bethuel, brother of Rebecca; father of Leah and Rachel.

people.name: Jacob
people.description: Son of Isaac and Rebecca, renamed Israel; father of the twelve tribal ancestors and Dinah.

explicit_ages.what: age when he refused Canaanite wives ("nine weeks of years")

people.identity_note: "Israel" refs added only where the man (not the nation) is meant.

people.name: Esau
people.description: Elder son of Isaac and Rebecca; killed by Jacob's arrow in battle at Hebron.
people.identity_note: Also had "two wives of the daughters of Canaan" / "two daughters of Heth" (25:1, 27:8), unnamed in Jubilees. 38:2 Jacob slays him.

people.name: Mahalath
people.description: Daughter of Ishmael, wife of Esau.

people.name: Abimelech
people.description: Philistine king of Gerar with whom Isaac dealt.

people.name: Ahuzzath
people.description: Friend of Abimelech.

people.name: Phicol
people.description: Commander of Abimelech's host.

people.name: Leah
people.description: Elder daughter of Laban, wife of Jacob, mother of six sons and Dinah.
people.identity_note: Died 36:21 (45th jubilee, 2nd week, 4th year).

people.name: Rachel
people.description: Younger daughter of Laban, wife of Jacob, mother of Joseph and Benjamin; died giving birth to Benjamin.

people.name: Zilpah
people.description: Laban's handmaid given to Leah; bore Gad and Asher to Jacob.

people.name: Bilhah
people.description: Sister of Zilpah, handmaid of Rachel; bore Dan and Naphtali to Jacob; died mourning Joseph.
people.identity_note: 28:9 "Bilhah, the sister of Zilpah".

people.name: Reuben
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Simeon
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Levi
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Judah
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Dan
people.description: Son of Jacob and Bilhah.

people.name: Naphtali
people.description: Son of Jacob and Bilhah.

people.name: Gad
people.description: Son of Jacob and Zilpah.

people.name: Asher
people.description: Son of Jacob and Zilpah.

people.name: Issachar
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Zebulon
people.description: Son of Jacob and Leah.

people.name: Joseph
people.description: Son of Jacob and Rachel.

explicit_ages.what: age when taken down to Egypt
age when he stood before Pharaoh

people.identity_note: 40:10 Pharaoh named him Sĕphânṭîphâns. Died 46:8 (46th jubilee, 6th week, 2nd year).

people.name: Benjamin
people.description: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel, born on the road at Ephrath.

people.name: Dinah
people.description: Only daughter of Jacob and Leah; defiled at Shechem aged twelve; died mourning Joseph.

explicit_ages.what: age when carried off to Shechem

people.name: ’Adâ
people.description: Wife of Reuben.

people.name: ’Adîbâ’a
people.description: Canaanite wife of Simeon.

people.name: Mêlkâ
people.description: Wife of Levi, of the daughters of Aram, of the seed of Terah.

people.name: Bêtasû’êl
people.description: Canaanite wife of Judah; mother of Er, Onan and Shelah.
people.identity_note: Mapped to existing judah-wife ("daughter of Shua" in Genesis). Spelled Bêtasû’êl at 34:20 and Bêdsû’êl at 41:7; died 41:7. 41:2 calls Er's mother "of the daughters of Canaan".

people.name: Hêzaqâ
people.description: Wife of Issachar.

people.name: Nî’îmân
people.description: Wife of Zebulon.
people.identity_note: Name marked corrupt by Charles (†Nî’îmân†).

people.name: ’Êglâ
people.description: Wife of Dan.

people.name: Rasû’û
people.description: Wife of Naphtali, from Mesopotamia.

people.name: Mâka
people.description: Wife of Gad.

people.name: ’Îjônâ
people.description: Wife of Asher.

people.name: ’Îjasaka
people.description: Wife of Benjamin.

people.name: Second wife of Simeon
people.description: Simeon's second wife, taken from Mesopotamia after he repented.

people.name: Shechem
people.description: Son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the land; defiled Dinah.
people.identity_note: Other occurrences of "Shechem" are the city or its men.

people.name: Hamor
people.description: The Hivite, prince of the land; father of Shechem.

people.name: Deborah
people.description: Rebecca's nurse, buried below Bethel.

people.name: Ephron
people.description: The Hittite from whom Abraham bought the double cave.

people.name: ’Adôrân
people.description: An Aramaean ally of Esau's sons, shot dead by Jacob.
people.identity_note: Possibly the same as ’Adurâm "the friend of their father" (37:9), but 37:9 may be a place (cf. the hill "in ’Adûrâm", 38:8-9); not merged.

people.name: Bâlâq
people.description: First king of Edom, son of Beor; his city was Danaba.

people.name: Beor
people.description: Father of Balaq king of Edom.

people.name: Jobab
people.description: King of Edom, son of Zara of Boser.

people.name: Zârâ
people.description: Father of Jobab king of Edom; of Boser.

people.name: ’Asâm
people.description: King of Edom from the land of Teman.

people.name: ’Adâth
people.description: King of Edom, son of Barad, who slew Midian in the field of Moab; his city was Avith.

people.name: Barad
people.description: Father of Adath king of Edom.

people.name: Salman
people.description: King of Edom from ’Amâsêqâ.

people.name: Saul
people.description: King of Edom from Ra'aboth by the river.

people.name: Ba’êlûnân
people.description: King of Edom, son of Achbor.

people.name: Achbor
people.description: Father of Ba'elunan king of Edom.

people.name: ’Adâth
people.description: Last listed king of Edom; husband of Maitabith.

people.name: Maiṭabîth
people.description: Wife of the second Adath king of Edom; daughter of Matarat.

people.name: Mâṭarat
people.description: Mother of Maitabith; daughter of Metabedza'ab.
people.identity_note: "daughter of Mâṭarat, the daughter of Mêtabêdzâ’ab" - Matarat is female here (as Matred in Gen 36:39).

people.name: Mêtabêdzâ’ab
people.description: Parent of Matarat (Genesis: Me-zahab).
people.identity_note: Gender not stated; Genesis 36:39 Me-zahab.

people.name: Potiphar
people.description: Eunuch of Pharaoh and chief cook who bought Joseph.
people.identity_note: 34:11 also calls him "priest of the city of ’Êlêw". Jubilees then calls Asenath's father "Potiphar, priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook" (40:10, 44:24), merging him with Potiphera; those refs are given under the potiphera entry.

people.name: Wife of Potiphar
people.description: Potiphar's wife who tried to seduce Joseph and slandered him.

people.name: Potiphar (father of Asenath)
people.description: Priest of Heliopolis whose daughter Asenath Joseph married.
people.identity_note: Text reads "Potiphar" and also calls him the chief cook, i.e. Jubilees identifies Asenath's father with Joseph's master. Mapped to potiphera for genealogy; reviewer may prefer potiphar.

people.name: Asenath
people.description: Egyptian wife of Joseph, daughter of the priest of Heliopolis; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim.

people.name: Chief butler
people.description: Pharaoh's chief butler, restored as Joseph foretold.

people.name: Chief baker
people.description: Pharaoh's chief baker, executed as Joseph foretold.

people.name: Chief of the prison guards
people.description: Keeper of the prison who entrusted everything to Joseph.

people.name: Pharaoh
people.description: King of Egypt who made Joseph second in the kingdom.
people.identity_note: 34:11 and 39:2 "eunuch of Pharaoh" also refer to him (39:2 counted under Potiphar only). 40:12 says Isaac died in the year Joseph stood before Pharaoh.

people.name: Er
people.description: Firstborn of Judah, married to Tamar; slain by the Lord.
people.identity_note: 41:2: his mother "was of the daughters of Canaan".

people.name: Onan
people.description: Son of Judah who refused levirate duty to Tamar; slain by the Lord.

people.name: Shelah
people.description: Son of Judah and Bedsuel, whom his mother would not let marry Tamar.

people.name: Tamar
people.description: Aramaean wife of Er; bore Perez and Zerah to Judah.
people.identity_note: 41:1 "a wife from the daughters of Aram". Her father and brothers appear unnamed (41:17).

people.name: Perez
people.description: Son of Judah and Tamar, twin of Zerah.

people.name: Zerah
people.description: Son of Judah and Tamar, twin of Perez.

people.name: Judah's shepherd, an Adullamite
people.description: Judah's Adullamite shepherd sent with the kid to Tamar.
people.identity_note: Genesis 38:20 names Judah's Adullamite friend Hirah; Jubilees calls him "his shepherd, an Adullamite" without a name.

people.name: Enoch
people.description: Son of Reuben; fought beside Simeon and Benjamin against Esau's sons (38:8).
people.identity_note: Jubilees spells Hanoch as "Enoch" (38:8 "Enoch, Reuben's son").

people.name: Pallu
people.description: Son of Reuben.

people.name: Hezron
people.description: Son of Reuben.

people.name: Carmi
people.description: Son of Reuben.

people.name: Jemuel
people.description: Son of Simeon.

people.name: Jamin
people.description: Son of Simeon.

notes: Source: R. H. Charles, The Book of Jubilees (SPCK, 1917), sacred-texts.com /bib/jub/. sacred-texts.com itself returned a Cloudflare challenge to curl, so every chapter page was fetched from the Internet Archive's capture of the same sacred-texts URLs (web.archive.org/web/2023id_/https://sacred-texts.com/bib/jub/jubNN.htm); raw HTML saved under dl/charles/jub/. Verse text was parsed from the HTML (footnotes removed); Charles's marginal A.M. figures were kept as 'charles_margin_am' for checking. Parsing caveats: a few verse numbers are missing or misprinted in the scan, so those verses are merged into the previous one: 3:23, 4:6, 13:3, 13:13 (printed '11'), 17:3, 18:2, 22:21, 22:26, 25:10 (printed '19'); also 9:2 'Sherri' = Shem, and the page header for 17:15-18 is misprinted 'xvi.'. Dating: anno_mundi = (jubilee-1)*49 + (week-1)*7 + year, the book's own scheme (50:4: 49 jubilees + 1 week + 2 years = 2410). Where the text says 'this jubilee/week', the value was taken from the surrounding verses (noted). Daggers (†...†) in Charles mark corrupt numbers; those events are flagged. Known inconsistencies: Ishmael's birth (14:24) vs Abram aged 86; Abraham's death year (22:1) vs his age 175 (Charles daggers 22:1); the tower dates (10:21-27). Kinship notes: most patriarchal wives are said to be daughters of 'his father's brother/sister' (first cousins); these uncles' own parents are not named and are not linked. Enos, Kenan and Cain each marry a 'sister' (Noam, Mualeleth, Awan); Sarai is 'the daughter of his father' (Terah), i.e. Abram's half-sister. Existing generic ids reused: cain-wife = Awan, noah-wife = Emzara, wife-shem/wife-ham/wife-japheth = the three city-namesake wives, judah-wife = Betasu'el/Bedsu'el, prison-warden, hirah (unnamed in Jubilees). Jubilees merges Potiphar and Potiphera: Asenath's father is 'Potiphar, priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook' (40:10, 44:24); mapped to potiphera with a note. Gender of Mêtabêdzâ'ab (Me-zahab, 38:23) is not stated and is given as 'unknown'. Ch. 44 adds sons of Dan not in Genesis (Sâmôn, Asûdî, ’Îjâka, Salômôn) and a son of Naphtali ‘Îv.
